description.value:
Maximum HP +8. Losing HP during your turn grants you and your memosprite damage +2 for 2 turns. When the memosprite disappears, gain +2 initiative next round, once per Ultimate cycle.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching remembrance Path required.
